known.fact: Writes "Drenge, I drenge som døde" for the fallen; murdered by the Peter Group on 4 Jan 1944, body in a ditch near Silkeborg with a note pinned to it. His verse is on the stone at Skæring Hede.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
